subject: QA-record control stdout cap (execFileSync default maxBuffer 1 MiB)
finding: the control spawns the sweep with execFileSync and no maxBuffer; the sweep's output on any branch carrying one family's run-9 evidence exceeds 1 MiB, so the child is killed and the planted control rows never arrive
landing: separate gate-only PR first (H7 hard rule: a gate change never lands with content it judges); family PRs re-run on a merge-of-main commit afterwards
